author: KEXP
description: Chicago-based instrumental trio Russian Circles join us Live on KEXP with their armory of heavy metal and post-rock. Live on KEXP with host Troy Nelson, the band share a performance of "Eluvial" and more.
title: Russian Circles performs "Eluvial" & more Live on KEXP
